2026 public holidays

  • 1 January – New Year’s Day
  • 2 January – New Year’s Day
  • 20 March – Eid- Al-Fitr (End of Ramadan)**
  • 23 March – NawRuz Day * (22 March)
  • 3 April – Good Friday
  • 6 April – Catholic Easter *(5 April)
  • 13 April – Orthodox Easter *(12 April)
  • 4 May – Early May Bank Holiday
  • 25 May – Spring bank Holiday
  • 27 May – Eid al-Adha (Feast of Sacrifice)**
  • 31 August – Summer bank holiday
  • 30 November – 28 Flag Day and Independence Day – 28 November
  • 1 December – 29 November -Independence Day* - 29 November
  • 25 December – Christmas Day
  • 28 December – 26 December Boxing Day

*Holidays falling on Saturday or Sunday are observed on Monday.

**Note: The Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha holidays may be subject to change according to the lunar calendar. In case of eventual changes, you will be notified accordingly

Consular section

The Consular section office works by appointment only and is therefore not open to the public at all times. See more information on how to make an appointment here.
